edits.from: export function charXpForLevel(lv) { return xpForLevelOn(LEVEL_ROWS, lv); }

edits.to: export function charLevelFromXp(xp) { { const x = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(xp) || 0)); if (x >= lawXp(LAW.from)) { let lo = LAW.from, hi = LAW.from * 2; while (lawXp(hi) <= x) hi *= 2; while (hi - lo > 1) { const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (lawXp(mid) <= x) lo = mid; else hi = mid; } return lo; } }
